item.cardSummary: Comet-struck is a Natural Event trait with a 2.5× multiplier.
item.obtainment: Falling stars during the Comet event apply this trait when they strike a Brainrot.
item.visuals: Yellow and blue comet sparks surround the Brainrot.

item.name: Snowy
item.cardSummary: Snowy is a Natural Event trait with a 2× multiplier.
item.obtainment: The Snow event randomly applies this trait to spawned Brainrots.
item.visuals: Snowflakes gather around the Brainrot.

item.name: Wet
item.cardSummary: Wet is a Natural Event trait with a 1.5× multiplier.
item.obtainment: The Rain event randomly applies this trait to spawned Brainrots.
item.visuals: Water droplets cover the Brainrot.
